definitions: A sum of money paid regularly (typically annually) by a company to its shareholders out of its profits (or reserves).
An individual's share of a dividend.
A payment made by a building society to its depositors.
A share of a surplus paid to policyholders in a mutual insurance company.
A benefit from an action or policy.
A number to be divided by another number.
examples: The company will pay a dividend of 10p per share.
He received a dividend from his investment.
The dividend from the policy was substantial.
In 15 divided by 3, 15 is the dividend.
